settings.title: The 4 C's
settings.text: Cut, colour, clarity and carat weight are what decide a diamond's beauty and its price. Of the four, cut does the most for sparkle.

settings.title: About lab-grown diamonds
settings.text: Grown rather than mined, and identical to a mined diamond in chemistry, structure and brilliance - at roughly 40% less.

settings.title: Lab-grown gemstones
settings.text: Real sapphires, rubies and emeralds with the same properties as their mined counterparts, in colours that are hard to find in nature.

settings.title: Stone comparison
settings.text: Where a lab-grown diamond sits next to a simulant such as cubic zirconia or moissanite, and how to tell one from the other.

settings.title: Find your ring size
settings.text: A printable ring sizer, an international conversion chart, and what to do when you are buying a surprise.

settings.title: Find the right metal
settings.text: Platinum, and 14K or 18K white, yellow and rose gold - how each wears day to day and which suits which stone.

settings.title: Jewellery care & cleaning
settings.text: How to clean your pieces at home, when to have them checked, and the habits that keep a setting secure for years.

settings.title: Glossary of jewellery terms
settings.text: Bezel, pave, culet, girdle - the words you will meet while you shop, in plain language.

settings.heading: Lab-Grown Diamond & Gemstone Education
settings.description: There is a lot to take in when you are choosing fine diamond and gemstone jewellery, from an engagement ring to a pair of everyday earrings. Explore the guides below to learn about diamonds and gemstones, caring for your jewellery, finding your ring size and more.
